notes.title: Major Update 1 Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p]The time has finally come...
I'm thrilled to announce that [b]Major Update 1 is officially live![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783165/24d6ed08258ee93f6204c256ed679fc863beb82c.png"][/img][/p][h3]Years of hard work[/h3][p]This update represents years of hard work, remastering, refining, and listening to community feedback. A lot of that time was spend on deep systems work that isn't always visible on the surface. Rewriting core gameplay loops, overhauling AI behavior, balancing combat flow, optimizing performance, and adding in the framework that will carry EXOME forward.[/p][p]These were not quick fixes. They required tearing things down, testing, iterating, and building them back up in a way that I can now expand on more easily.[/p][p]Major Update 1 also delivers a long list of improvements, bug fixes, and quality of life changes that I believe make the experience more intense, more immersive, and ultimately more rewarding for both solo and co-op players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783165/6db02663eb28a404a70e4f7aaea5ad4c83c992fb.png"][/img][/p][h3]Thank you[/h3][p]I want to sincerely thank every single one of you who stuck with me through the long wait and supported the game during its early stages. Your patience, feedback, and encouragement were crucial, and this update would not exist without the community standing behind it.[/p][p][/p][p]Jump in, try it out, and let me know what you think. I can't wait to hear your thoughts on all the changes.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Procedural Event System
[/b]One of the major developments has been the implementation of a new procedural event system. This system introduces dynamic and unpredictable outcomes to the platforms, ensuring that no two playthroughs are alike.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weather System[/b]
From torrential rainstorms and snowstorms to scorching heatwaves, the weather will not only influence the visual aesthetics but also alter gameplay dynamics. For instance, a sudden downpour might decrease visibility and intensify combat, while clear skies could make things more manageable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Difficulty System[/b]
There is a now a difficulty system to cater to a wider audience. Whether you're a seasoned gamer seeking a challenge or a casual player looking for a more relaxed experience. This ensures that everyone can play at their own preferred pace.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Partial Controller Support
[/b]Can be played with a controller but menus aren't supported yet.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Poise System for players and monsters
[/b]Players and monsters now both have a poise. Players will visual stumble, fall or get thrown back if their poise breaks in a short enough time. Monsters can be staggered if their poise breaks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Player Dodging[/b]
Added a dodging mechanic for the player. I've wanted the player to have more options on how to deal with attackers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Player Melee
[/b]Get your steel toes on because you're going to need them with all that worm kicking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Explosive Weaponry[/b]
Added explosive weapons in order to help the players deal with larger swarms of enemies. Who doesn't love blowing things up?[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Bullet Ballistics[/b]
Added bullet drop and ricochet to all weapons. Some weapons also have tracer rounds. Bullets also have travel time, influenced by the muzzle velocity of the weapon being fired.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Companion: T.E.S.A.[/b]
Added combat assistant to support solo players in their playthroughs. She will draw some of the monsters’ aggro and help deal damage accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Save System
[/b]After every update in the past, players would be required to start a new save game. This new save system will allow save game migrations for future updates so that you don't have to keep starting over with every update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Long-awaited Boss Fight[/b]
I'm thrilled to share that the long awaited boss fight is finally in the game. I hope you find this fight as fun and challenging as it was to make![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Monsters[/h3][list][*][p]Monsters have poise now and are capable of being staggered if they receive enough poise damage in a short time period[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters will now look at their target[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters have a varied set of abilities that they will use[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters have a incoming damage buffer that will let them update their target to the highest incoming damage source[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters' ragdoll will now freeze in place if it is old enough[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters now have a chance to study their target before trying to attack again[/p][/*][*][p]Event monsters that are unable to be collected will quickly dissolve[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed framerate issues when there are many monsters active[/p][/*][*][p]Wildlife can now lay down to rest[/p][/*][*][p]Wildlife will now react to gunshots they hear or bullets hitting nearby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where wildlife would spawn en masse in tight spaces on the map[/p][/*][*][p]Added micro-wormholes that monsters jump out of[/p][/*][*][p]There is now a chance of a "wild wormhole event"[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Weapons[/h3][list][*][p]Added Grenade Launcher[/p][/*][*][p]Added Rocket Launcher[/p][/*][*][p]Added Glowstick throwable[/p][/*][*][p]Added Secondary Weapon upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Players weapon reload animations are smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapons being visible while using their scopes[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll wheel now goes to next/previous weapon slot[/p][/*][*][p]UI fixes regarding weapon information presented to player[/p][/*][*][p]Reload cancelling is now much smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons now have their own unique muzzle velocities[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper rifle now shoots a tracer round[/p][/*][*][p]Bullets have drop, travel time and can use tracers for select weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Bullets have a chance to ricochet and continue to cause damage[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled 4th weapon slot for now - it will be utilized in the future[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted visuals of Frag Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Various visual updates to sniper rifle scope[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Player[/h3][list][*][p]Players now have poise and will get staggered, fall down or get thrown if their poise breaks hard enough[/p][/*][*][p]Players can be revived in place instead of being respawned in place[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now perform a melee attack[/p][/*][*][p]Added a square reticle to indicate if an interaction available[/p][/*][*][p]Added in-game military time to top left of player HUD[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now boost the rematerialization process while respawning, this costs MTR per second while boosting[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now dodge roll in any direction[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now switch camera to other shoulder[/p][/*][*][p]Added new HUD mini-map that shows your immediate area[/p][/*][*][p]Players no longer start with pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Added T.E.S.A. and her deployment throwable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player hand placement on all weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Increased sitting health recovery[/p][/*][*][p]Added notifications when buying weapons and upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Can now rotate character around in lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Player stamina bar will flash if there's not enough stamina to do an action[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced respawn materialization time from 60s to 45s[/p][/*][*][p]Joining players to a boss fight in progress will be put into spectator mode, until the boss fight is over[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Misc.[/h3][list][*][p]Updated to Unreal Engine 5.6[/p][/*][*][p]Added radial menu that is used for various functions the players can do[/p][/*][*][p]Changed currency of CR (Credits) to MTR (Matter)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tab panel for Map[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tab panel for Logs[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tab panel for Inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Map is now grid cell based and cells are hidden until visited[/p][/*][*][p]Updated various markers on map[/p][/*][*][p]Map icons for platforms now indicate if the platform has been completed or not[/p][/*][*][p]Added sharpness slider in display settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added weather volume slider to audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty setting, can be changed mid-playthrough if desired[/p][/*][*][p]Some upgrades will now require another upgrade to be purchased first[/p][/*][*][p]Kiosks can now scroll if the content is long enough[/p][/*][*][p]Moved gamma, field of vision, and motion blur to display settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added new log entries and updated others[/p][/*][*][p]Updated lobby to be a little more "ethereal"[/p][/*][*][p]Added several new POIs[/p][/*][*][p]Added underwater effects[/p][/*][*][p]Default Global Illumination is now Lumen. There is an option to turn GI off completely or use Screen Space Illumination[/p][/*][*][p]Added NVIDIA Reflex toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby browser details showing correct values for number of players and ping[/p][/*][*][p]And tons of other bug fixes and quality of life improvements...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]Gamepad vibration feedback is currently missing[/p][/*][*][p]Player indicators on the map can become stuck after a player revives. Rejoining the session resolves it temporarily[/p][/*][*][p]Clients may not see the host’s recently purchased weapon[/p][/*][*][p]T.E.S.A. may acquire an incorrect target and stop firing. Redeploying her fixes it for now[/p][/*][*][p]T.E.S.A. initially runs to the host even when spawned by another player[/p][/*][*][p]Rare bug causes players to appear to be firing a holstered weapon. Most commonly occurs when acquiring all weapons for the first time. Switching weapons fixes it for now[/p][/*][*][p]Platform events will sometimes cancel and will have to be restarted[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Additional Notes[/h3][list][*][p]Update 2 is already in development. It will introduce a new map, new weapons, new enemies, new upgrades, and additional systems - all built on top of what’s now in place with Update 1.[/p][/*][*][p]If you encounter a bug or want to provide feedback, you can do so through the in-game feedback panel or on the EXOME Discord ([url="https://discord.gg/eUVQDBVNVE"]https://discord.gg/eUVQDBVNVE[/url]).[/p][/*][*][p]Content creators: all music in EXOME is properly licensed and safe to use in videos or streams.[/p][/*][*][p]From the bottom of my heart - thank you for your patience and support. Your feedback continues to have a direct impact on EXOME.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning, and there much more to come...[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,
"rudefrog"
RudeFrog Studios[/p]

notes.title: Major Update 1 Testing Phase Begins
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p]The preview is available to play right... now. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][h3]What's in this update?[/h3][p]Just to reiterate a little, many of EXOME’s systems have undergone full reworks to support my long-term plans for EXOME’s future. In the initial build, many of these implementations were glorified prototypes. I didn’t put much effort into them at the time because I wasn’t sure if EXOME would find an audience. But it looks like it has and this means that many systems and mechanics needed to be reworked to be more modular. This will reduce the time required for future content and potentially allow for more frequent updates.[/p][p][/p][p]The main goal of this update is to implement the boss fight and properly conclude this area. With modular systems now in place, Update 2 and future updates won’t take as long to develop. By taking the time to restructure things now, subsequent updates should be able to be released much faster.[/p][p][/p][p]This update has been a monumental task for me. Going forward, I’ll be switching to smaller, more manageable updates - not only for my own sake, but also to help everyone stay better caught up on things as EXOME develops.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's next?[/h3][p]During this testing phase I'll be getting things ready for the full release and updating the preview branch as things get fixed. The full release will happen after I'm satisfied that most the problems are fixed. I'm not sure how long this is going to take, but I don't suspect it will take super long.[/p][p][/p][p]As you play the preview, keep in mind that there is a higher potential for encountering bugs that haven't been seen yet. notes.title: EXOME Update Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am thrilled to announce the latest update for EXOME. This update brings a host of new features and improvements.

This update introduces the Fragmentation Grenades which will help you turn the tide. I've also added four additional player upgrades that will help you deal with the onslaught.

I've also addressed some of the bugs and glitches that were reported by players to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

I hope you enjoy this update to EXOME and I look forward to your continued support. As a solo developer, your feedback is incredibly important. I welcome your comments and suggestions as I continue to improve and add content to the game. Feel free to let me know what you think through the in-game feedback panel or the EXOME Discord Server ([url=https://discord.gg/eUVQDBVNVE]https://discord.gg/eUVQDBVNVE[/url]).

Happy gaming!

RudeFrog Studios



ADDITIONS
- Added Nvidia DLSS Support
- Added Stamina Bar
- Added Fragmentation Grenades
- Added Armor Plating Upgrade
- Added Reload Speed Upgrade
- Added Ammo Bags Upgrade
- Added Grenade Pouch Upgrade
- Added Materialization Kiosk
- Added Additional Sitting Animations
- Added something that [spoiler]keeps its distance while watching[/spoiler] (spoiler)
- Added something that [spoiler]is looking for you[/spoiler] (spoiler)
- Added something that [spoiler]will hunt you down[/spoiler] (spoiler)

FIXES
- Updated to Unreal Engine 5.1.1
- Updated early access disclaimer
- Fixed screen flashing for clients when joining
- Fixed occurrence of player surviving intended kill damage
- Fixed a platform cheesing spot
- Fixed recoil framerate issue
- Fixed weapon bar on hud messing up briefly when alt-tabbing
- Reduced Pistol recoil by 50%
- Reduced value of Medium Pots to 150
- Reduced value of Large Pots to 300
- Restyled health bar
- Revamped church platforming
- Now small chance of wild strong predator early game
- Unknown Specimen will no longer spawn in the wild
- Slightly reduced base reload speed of Shotgun
- Weapons will show a quick materialization when bought
- Increased recharge time for Drone Beacon
- Players will now respawn at the Materialization Kiosk

notes.title: Small Patch v0.2.9
notes.notes:
[b]v0.2.9[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed monsters hovering away while fleeing (even though it was funny some times)
[*] Fixed issue with monsters getting stuck on nothing apparent while fleeing
[*] Platforms will now deactivate if all players are not close enough to active platform
[*] Increased visibility in area surrounding most difficult platform
[*] Added spawn protection for players just joining
[*] Added additional clarity to “Investigate nearby platform” objective location
[*] Reduced the amount of on-screen blood that can occur
[*] Moved Fill Ammo button to be more apparent
[*] Put away Christmas decorations
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch v0.2.8
notes.notes:
[b]v0.2.8[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where weapon would sometimes double fire
[*] Fixed issue of player being unable to shoot after rapidly switching to slot 4 and firing
[*] Fixed issue where clients joining mid-game were able to see “ghost” pots
[*] Fixed issue with chat box fading out while typing
[*] Fixed various client related issues with kiosk sound replication
[*] Fixed issue with chat log not scrolling down to show entire message
[*] Can now scroll chat log
[*] Ammo containers now fill ammo as expected
[*] Key bindings will now save changes as expected
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch v0.2.6
notes.notes:
[b]v0.2.6[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes clients would get stuck on loading screen
[*] Fixed issue where you were able to crouch jump to clip into things
[*] Added even stronger activation indications to platforms
[*] Reduced attenuation of proximity sound of collectables
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch v0.2.5
notes.notes:
[b]Old saves will not work with this update. I apologize. I am working on ways to prevent this from happening in the future. Thank you for your patience![/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with checkboxes on the server browser
[*] Fixed issue where panels would duplicate if player respawned while having them open
[*] Fixed issue with some monsters not showing on thermal vision
[*] Fixed various issues with map
[*] Dead monsters’ thermal signature now fades over time
[*] Expanded objectives to help with early guidance
[*] Updated some log entries
[*] Collectables now emanate a beeping sound to help locate them
[*] You can now use either E or Left Click to interact with a hologram screen
[*] Removed chromatic aberration and film grain noise from entire game
[*] Reduced pistol damage infliction by 50%
[*] Added unstuck button to Session Settings panel
[/list]
